notes: Dashboard v2: hero with System Status strip (Monitoring, Scheduler last tick, Meta (#4) in last 24h, Update), 'Aaj ka kaam' panel (today's scheduled + next 3, FAILED with Retry, tokens expiring, Missing/Needs-review, low stock), Next Best Slot (history-only, prefills Smart Schedule), 6-card KPI row with 7-day sparklines + delta chips and a collapsible More-stats panel, Page Health Score donut (app's own score, not a Meta metric) with weakest Pages + why lists, Growth Movers from followerHistory only, Inactive Pages (no recorded post for N days, default 7) with a warning notification, 7-day calendar strip opening Scheduled Posts filtered to that day, Reach/Engagement locked card, Setup progress replacing the Promo card. Status pill tints (.st-SCHEDULED/.st-PENDING/.st-PUBLISHED/.st-CANCELLED/.st-DRAFT/.st-APPROVED/.st-REJECTED), --danger token, Compact density toggle in Settings > Appearance. Quick Access tiles leave the dashboard (all actions stay in the sidebar + hero shortcuts); the Page Detail drawer and Calendar view come in v2.50.0.
